tagline: Fund fan ideas with clear rules.
intro: Pool USDC for fan ads and goods, with clear budgets, reviewed payouts and claimable refunds.
projectSub: Ads, goods, and cafés with visible funding rules.
emptyTitle: Our first projects are on their way
emptyBody: Projects will appear after their plans and funding rules have been reviewed. No campaigns are accepting funds yet.
previewNote: Funding is not open for this campaign. No contract has been deployed and no contributions are being collected.
rulesSub: Know where your contribution goes, and what happens next.
rule1Body: USDC stays in the campaign contract until an approved payout or an eligible refund.
rule2Body: Each recipient and budget cap is fixed. A separate reviewer must approve every payout.
rule3Body: After settlement, claim your share of unused funds. A missed goal allows a full refund after finalization. Claims require a separate transaction.
footer: Made for fans. Guided by shared plans.
organizer: A fictional project by LUMI Together
storyTitle: A little light for a special day
story: Imagine a birthday message brightening a Seoul station, and a small café corner where fans can leave their wishes. This fictional project shows how a shared plan, a fixed budget and clear refund rules come together on FanPot.
noFigures: Live funding and supporter counts will appear only after a real contract is activated.
notReady: This campaign is not accepting contributions.
noSupporters: A space for everyone who joins. No supporters yet.
noUpdates: The first update will be shared here.
noLedger: No contract or transaction records exist for this campaign.
privacyHint: Wallet addresses and transaction amounts are public on the blockchain.
meBody: Your contributions and refunds are recorded in the campaign contract. Open a campaign to see its public records.
proofBody: The Arc Mainnet factory is deployed and its receipt and configuration are public. No Mainnet campaign or contribution has been verified yet. Wallet actions are paused while a MetaMask site warning remains unresolved.
helpTitle: A shared plan, from start to finish
helpBody: Each campaign shows its network and funding rules. Contributions use USDC and may need a token approval followed by a separate contribution transaction. Refunds require a claim transaction. Never send tokens directly to a campaign address.
privacyBody: FanPot does not collect names or social handles. Wallet addresses and transaction amounts are public on Arc and can be linked through other public information. The site has no user database or analytics.
termsBody: Read the network label and funding rules on each campaign before contributing. Testnet campaigns use test tokens. Mainnet transfers and network fees use real USDC. A funded goal does not guarantee delivery. Refunds depend on contract conditions and require a claim transaction. No platform fee is charged.
